title: DTFuzz
summary: A research project for detecting and mitigating regression defects in deep learning tabular data models, using fuzz testing and feature selection to build a robust testing pipeline. It vendors a copy of CTGAN under dtfuzz/autoencoder/ctgan, whose data_transformer.py imports rdt's ClusterBasedNormalizer and OneHotEncoder for tabular data preprocessing.
needs: Vendored ctgan directory includes rdt-based data_transformer.py and TVAE model; unclear if these are actually invoked in the fuzzing pipeline beyond train_tvae.py import.
